blocks.title: Open AI Canvas in Astravia
blocks.description: Run the open-source AI canvas locally and interact with it through the host agent. Text-to-image, image-to-video, and more — all from your workspace.

showcase.user_prompt: List my canvas projects and create a new one for the product launch video.
showcase.assistant_reply: I found 3 projects. Created project 'Product Launch Video'. You can now open it in the canvas to add nodes.

items.title: Full canvas, locally hosted
items.description: The complete open-ai-canvas backend and frontend run on this machine, built as native binaries for your OS. All canvas data stays in the plugin's data directory.

items.title: Use Astravia's models inside the canvas
items.description: Astravia lends the canvas its text models over a local bridge, so one key is enough. In the other direction the canvas's own image and video models are registered as an Astravia media provider — keys stay in the canvas, generation still runs there.

items.title: Host agent control via MCP
items.description: Manage projects, canvases, nodes and generation tasks through the host agent. 18 MCP tools, including building a whole workflow in a single request.

items.title: One-click lifecycle
items.description: Start and stop the canvas from the workspace view. The host manages the backend, the Node runtime and the agent process.

items.title: Install the plugin
items.description: Install from the marketplace. The plugin ships a small launcher; the 300+ MB native runtime (backend, web app, agent) is downloaded for your platform on first start.

items.title: Start the canvas
items.description: Open the workspace view and click 'Start Canvas'. A built-in progress page tracks the first-time download; the canvas opens automatically once the backend is ready.

items.title: Open and log in
items.description: Click 'Open in Browser' to open the canvas UI. The first user can register automatically.

items.title: Connect models
items.description: Text: press 'Use Astravia's text models in the canvas'. Each model is written into the canvas's "Astravia" channel together with its capability parameters and one free price tier; the plugin then reads the canvas catalog back and tells you how many models are actually usable — not just that something was sent. Media: press 'Use these models in Astravia' — the image and video models you configured in the canvas then appear in Astravia's own generate entry. You can unregister them at any time.

items.title: Use the agent
items.description: After logging in, the host agent can build and edit workflows on the open canvas, and reports each apply back in the plugin view.

blocks.content: Text is bridged one way (Astravia → canvas). Image and video models travel the other way: their names and capabilities are registered with Astravia, while the API keys stay inside the canvas and every generation still runs there. Reference-image modes (image-to-image, image-to-video) are not bridged yet.

First launch downloads the native runtime for your platform from GitHub Releases and verifies its checksum before starting. Expect several minutes on a slow connection; later launches start immediately. The host does not hold the canvas's API keys, so revoking access means removing the registration in the workspace view.
